relationship: One grouped distribution is represented by histogram bar areas and cumulative-frequency growth, so changing an interval affects both displays and quartile read-offs.

learnerLoop.action: Build intervals, read quartiles and alter a histogram bar.
learnerLoop.modelChange: Frequency density, bar area, cumulative totals and quartile estimates update together.
learnerLoop.evidence: The linked histogram, curve, highlights and working checks expose the same grouped data.
learnerLoop.nextDecision: Use the linked representation to locate the next quartile or explain the IQR.

invariants: Histogram area represents frequency even when class widths differ.
Cumulative frequency never decreases and ends at the total frequency.
safeAdaptations: Vary valid grouped intervals and frequencies while retaining linked displays.
Change working support without disconnecting quartile evidence from the cumulative curve.
nonGoals: Using bar height alone as frequency for unequal-width classes.

task.description: Current problem statement and supplied quantities.
task.visibility: Shown at the start of each problem or stage.

model.description: Operated construction and its live measurements; see quantities for what is given and revealed.
model.visibility: Present for the current problem; child controls and readouts follow the states described below.

working.description: Ordered calculations, learner entries and consequential evidence for the current task.
working.visibility: Present for the current problem; child controls and readouts follow the states described below.

completion.description: Achievement, next task or learning transition.
completion.visibility: Shown only when the local completion conditions below are satisfied; representation controls are separately identified.

progress.description: Existing construction/read-off/summary progression and saved working.
progress.visibility: Present for the current problem; child controls and readouts follow the states described below.

controls.description: Working ownership, current-step reset and sample generation.
controls.visibility: Present for the current problem; child controls and readouts follow the states described below.

grouped-data.description: Supplied unequal class boundaries and class frequencies.
grouped-data.domain: Journey time in minutes and frequency in pupils.
grouped-data.output: Current interval values and completed history rows are visible.

density-total.description: Per-class density and next cumulative total are distinct quantities; repeated fields are indexed instances across intervals.
density-total.domain: Pupils per minute and cumulative pupils.
density-total.source: Produced by drag or typed entry according to ownership().
density-total.output: Density controls bar height/area; the next total controls the curve rise.

quartiles-iqr.description: Q1, median and Q3 are three read-offs of the same distribution; IQR is Q3−Q1, a distinct derived spread.
quartiles-iqr.domain: Ranks in pupils; read-offs and IQR in minutes.
quartiles-iqr.source: Learner positions the ruler at each target rank; All first requires the rank calculation.
quartiles-iqr.output: Accepted read-offs are estimates within grouped intervals; IQR entry controls the bracket.

modes.none: Drag each density bar, then its cumulative point; quartile ranks and IQR working are shown.
modes.some: Density is entered and controls its bar; cumulative rise remains a drag. IQR is entered.
modes.all: Density and cumulative totals are entered; quartile rank entries unlock the read-off ruler; IQR is entered.
modes.experiment: After the summary, an optional experiment changes an interval density and recomputes frequencies, cumulative totals and median.

dependencies: A class requires barOK, riseOK and ownedWorkReady before moving to the next interval.
The cumulative point is unavailable until density is correct.
All class intervals precede Q1/median/Q3; required ranks gate the ruler; Q3 precedes IQR.
implementation.completion: Each manipulation is checked on release. The final guide is reached after three accepted quartiles and the IQR calculation (shown automatically at None); experiment remains optional.
